meta.name: Tendency Test - axis architecture
meta.purpose: Per-bucket battery of 8 family-specific axes. Module 2 does NOT route between buckets; it produces a radar plot plus a flavour sub-tendency label derived from the nearest sub-ideology anchors.
meta.labelRule: Nearest sub-ideology anchor gives the primary label; if the second-nearest is within 15% match, emit a compound label (e.g. 'Stalinist-Orthodox, Third-Worldist Lean').
meta.density: 12 questions per axis, 96 per bucket; short form 6 per axis, 48.

weightPattern.note: Fixed per-axis ordering makes keyed balance and weight balance true by construction: 52/52 full, 27/27 short form.

meta.umbrellaNote: Entries flagged umbrella are critics' labels or family-level aspirations rather than distinct positions. They are placed on the radar but excluded from pairwise-separation scoring.
meta.culturalAxis: The Traditionalist<->Progressive appendage is excluded from every bucket's 8 axes by design. No axis below should correlate strongly with it; if one does, that bucket has only 7 real axes.
